jobs.description:
Line Supervisor | 2 Shifts

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

Are you an experienced operator who is ready to take the next step in your career?
Do you already have some initial experience in leadership and are you able to motivate and guide a team of employees?

Job Description:

• You are responsible for the production line assigned to you.
• Your team consists of about 9 employees (both permanent and temporary staff).
• You motivate your entire team and ensure a positive atmosphere and strong cooperation.
• You also actively take part in the production process, monitoring and controlling it.
• You stay alert and suggest improvements.
• You are able to solve small technical issues.
• During shift changes, you are responsible for the handover.

PROFIEL

• You have experience leading a team.
• You have strong social and communication skills, allowing you to communicate effectively (also with technicians and other departments).
• Working with people of different nationalities does not intimidate you.
• You can express yourself well in English. Basic knowledge of Bulgarian or Polish is a plus.
• Your formal education is less important, but you have a strong motivation to keep learning.
• You are mature, flexible, stress-resistant, and able to work independently.
• You take responsibility for your work.
• You report to the Production Manager.

AANBOD

What do you get?

• A varied and responsible position where you get the opportunity to further develop your leadership skills.
• Work in a dynamic environment, where no two days are the same and you are constantly challenged to optimize processes and lead a motivated team.
• A commuting allowance, so you can travel to and from work comfortably and cost-effectively.

STUDIEVEREISTEN
Geen specifieke studievereisten
.

You will be responsible for:
 

 
• Moving and dragging foam blocks
 
• Manually feeding the machine
 
• Picking up foam scraps from the floor
 
• Keeping the workplace clean and organized
 
• Working together with your colleague to ensure a smooth production process 

 
• You speak Dutch or English.
 
• You are physically strong and enjoy active work.
 
• You can perform repetitive tasks accurately.
 
• You enjoy working together with a colleague.
 
• Experience is not required; motivation is more important.
 
• You can work in a day shift, and when production volumes increase, you are willing to work in a 2-shift system.

For a company in the meat industry Oudenaarde, we are looking for an All-round Technician.

What will your responsibilities be?

• You will be responsible for corrective, preventive and improvement-oriented maintenance of the machinery, equipment and buildings. 
• You will carry out scheduled maintenance and perform the necessary repairs. 
• You will ensure the production machinery operates optimal.

Who are you?

• You are able to identify and resolve technical faults. 
• You have a good command of either Dutch or English.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

Do you enjoy technical, hands-on work and want to see the tangible results of what you do? As an on-site installer, you will help install and finish plastic installations directly at customer locations, mainly in the agricultural sector.

You will work on a day schedule, on different projects and at various locations, with a salary between €17 and €19 per hour, plus additional benefits.

 
• 
Install plastic walls, pipes and connection components.

 
• 
Carry out hot-air welding work.

 
• 
Install fastening elements and ensure the work is finished neatly.

 
• 
Assist with basement fitting and the installation of wall and facade cladding.

 
• 
Help position installations using a crane.

 
• 
Perform simple electrical work, such as pulling cables.

 
• 
You enjoy working outdoors and at different locations.

 
• 
You pay attention to correct installation and proper finishing of the work.

 
• 
You enjoy learning new things.

 
• 
Experience in the field is an advantage, but not required.

 
• 
You do not need prior knowledge of plastic welding, as this is taught within the company.

 
• 
You speak English.

Step into a role that molds the very foundation of tomorrow's structures. As a Concrete Worker, you play a crucial role in preparing, placing, and finishing concrete for various structural projects. Work with a dedicated team to bring blueprints to life, ensuring that every measure is executed to perfection.

Picture your day starting with a collaborative briefing with your team, followed by hands-on work where you prepare formwork, place and finish concrete, and ensure every detail aligns with design specifications. You will be reading construction plans, placing reinforcements, and ensuring site cleanliness, all while maintaining a safe and productive work environment.

Are you ready to take your construction career to the next level? If you are motivated, physically fit, and willing to learn, we want you! Apply now and become a part of a team that values skill and dedication.

• At least 1 year of experience in construction

• Ability to read construction drawings

• Communicative English

• Physically fit and hardworking

• Motivated to learn and grow

• Flexible and hands-on attitude

• Own transportation is a plus

• VCA certificate or willingness to obtain one

jobs.occupation: IT Project Manager – Software Development & Agile Delivery
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Plan and organize complex IT software development and implementation projects from inception to completion.
• Monitor project scope, timing, budget, capacity, and risks to ensure successful delivery.
• Coordinate multidisciplinary teams and external vendors within a multi-project delivery context.
• Facilitate release management, implementations, and migrations while ensuring rigorous quality control.
• Provide transparent status reporting and decision-making data for management and stakeholders.
• Implement and professionalize agile methodologies including Scrum and Kanban across teams.

Requirements

• You have a Master's degree or equivalent through relevant professional experience.
• You bring 5+ years of experience as a project leader in infrastructure or software development projects.
• You possess expertise in project management methodologies such as Prince2 or PMBok.
• You have extensive experience with agile frameworks, specifically Scrum and Kanban.
• You bring proficiency in project and backlog management tools like Jira or Azure DevOps.
• You possess a strong understanding of release, test, and quality management within IT environments.
• You have experience managing complex dependencies across multiple teams, projects, and stakeholders.
• You're able to translate business needs into technical solutions while managing budget and capacity.
• You are proactive, analytical, and possess excellent facilitation and presentation skills.
• You are native in Dutch with professional knowledge of English.
Nice to Haves

• Knowledge of ITIL principles and service management processes.
• Proficiency in MS Project and MS Office.
• Experience with Enterprise Architecture alignment and data migrations.
• Involvement in RFI, RFP, or vendor selection trajectories.
• Experience with demand management and financial forecasting.

Our client is a well-established and reputable financial institution specializing in wealth management and investment services. With a strong focus on expertise, long-term relationships, and service excellence, the company offers a collaborative and professional work environment where employees are encouraged to grow and develop their careers.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage the full lifecycle of client files, from onboarding to closure.
• Perform AML/KYC checks and assess client documentation and risk profiles.
• Collect, verify, and maintain accurate client data.
• Ensure compliance with internal procedures and regulatory requirements.
• Collaborate closely with commercial, legal, and compliance teams.
• Identify and report operational risks when necessary.
• Participate in various departmental and process improvement projects.

• Previous experience in a similar administrative, KYC, compliance, or client support role within the financial services sector.
• Good knowledge of AML, KYC, MiFID, FATCA, CRS, GDPR, or similar regulations.
• Strong analytical and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• A proactive team player with strong communication abilities.
• Fluent in French and Dutch, with a good command of English.

• 
You will drive and operate the Terberg truck for goods handling and truck operations.

 
• 
You will drive the trailers to the loading and unloading docks and transport them within the industrial park.

 
• 
Ensure safe and efficient internal transport of goods.

 
• 
You will sometimes assist in the warehouse: loading, unloading, receiving, driving the forklift.

 
• 
Work within rotating shifts: 06:00 - 14:00 and 14:00 - 22:00 (two shifts).

 
• 
Previous truck driving experience or CE license is required.

 
• 
Proficiency in English (and/or Dutch) is necessary for effective communication.

 
• 
Comfortable working in a rotating shifts.

 
• 
Safety-conscious, motivated, and reliable.

Do you have kitchen experience and enjoy working with fresh products? Are you hands-on, reliable, and looking for a stable job with opportunities to grow? Then we would love to meet you!
 

Your responsibilities
 

As a Production Kitchen Worker, you will be part of a motivated team responsible for preparing and processing fresh vegetables on a daily basis.
 

Your tasks include:
 

 
• Cleaning and washing vegetables.
 
• Cutting and preparing vegetables both manually and with machines.
 
• Operating vegetable cutting equipment safely and efficiently.
 
• Maintaining a clean and hygienic work environment.
 
• Following quality and food safety standards. 

 
• Previous experience in a professional kitchen is required.
 
• You are comfortable with physical work and enjoy staying active.
 
• You work accurately and pay attention to hygiene.
 
• You are available to work on Mondays and Saturdays.
 
• You can start work between 6:00 AM and 7:00 AM.
 
• You speak English or Dutch.
 
• Experience working in Belgium is not required.

Responsibilities

• Manage and maintain Windows and Linux servers within virtualized environments.
• Execute system updates and patches through formal change control processes.
• Perform backup, restore, monitoring, and troubleshooting of the server infrastructure.
• Support infrastructure qualification processes, including IQ/OQ, and prepare necessary documentation.
• Ensure data integrity by managing access controls and monitoring audit trails.
• Participate in deviations, CAPA processes, and infrastructure audits.
• Operate in accordance with SOPs and maintain accurate technical documentation.

Requirements

• 3+ years experience in server or system administration.
• Advanced knowledge of Windows Server and Linux.
• Hands-on experience with virtualization platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V.
• Professional experience working within a GxP environment.
• You are accurate, structured, and comfortable following strict procedures.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English.
Nice to Haves

• Knowledge of EU GMP Annex 11, 21 CFR Part 11, or GAMP 5.
• Bachelor's degree in IT or a related field.

Do you have a technical mindset?Are you passionate about machines and technology? Do you live near Waregem? 
Then this opportunity is for you!

For a leading company specialized in certified labels, we are looking for a Technical Operator in 2 Shifts or a Fixed Morning Shift!

What are your tasks?

• Operating complex machines on the production line
• Setting temperatures
• Setting parameters
• Filling machines with very precise quantities of materials
• Adhering to strict safety regulations

Who are you?

• You have a strong technical background, gained through education or work experience. 
• You speak Nederlands or English.
• You have your own transport.
• Experience in this sector is a plus!

This large Belgian company plays a key role and manages an extensive and technically complex network. Behind the scenes, high-performing and reliable IT systems ensure that operational processes run safely and efficiently. Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.
You will join an experienced team operating in an Enterprise environment where quality, collaboration, and long-term vision are central.

Jobomschrijving

You will contribute to the development and optimization of applications that support operations with real-time data & feedback. You will implement new features and improve existing modules within a modern frontend stack where performance, reliability, and usability are key.
You will also support the team with your technical expertise in Angular, helping maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability, and reusability. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, UX specialists, and product stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum environment to deliver robust and scalable enterprise applications.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with Angular & front-end development in general
• Experience in Java-environments
•  10 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

As Lead Full Stack Developer, you take a key role in the further development and evolution of a suite of business-critical applications used in real-time operational environments.
You remain strongly hands-on in both backend and frontend development, working primarily with .NET and Angular, while also guiding technical choices, improving existing implementations and helping shape upcoming solutions. You challenge current approaches where needed and translate complex technical topics into clear and pragmatic proposals.
A major part of the role is technical leadership. You support and coach other developers, promote knowledge sharing and help maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability and software design. You work closely with analysts, architects, testers and other developers within an Agile/Scrum setup.
You also keep a close eye on delivery, scope and technical risks. When dependencies, architectural concerns or implementation issues arise, you identify them early and help the team move towards a robust and sustainable solution.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience in .NET & Angular
• +15 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Are you ready to take your career to the next level as a CNC Turner/Programmer? This role places you at the heart of precision manufacturing, where you'll operate and program CNC turning machines using advanced Heidenhain and Siemens control systems. Your expertise will ensure the production of high-quality, custom-made spare parts for various industrial applications.

A typical day involves collaborating with a team of five skilled professionals, programming and operating CNC machines, and ensuring finished products meet rigorous quality standards. You'll also engage in measuring and inspecting workpieces and occasionally assist in hydraulic cylinder repairs. A clean, organized workspace is a must to maintain safety and efficiency.

If you're passionate about precision and innovation, apply today to join a team that values expertise and teamwork!

• Proven experience as a CNC Turner/Programmer

• Proficiency in Heidenhain and Siemens control systems

• Strong attention to detail

• Ability to work both independently and as part of a team

• Experience in custom machining and measuring techniques

• Good level of English

• Willingness to work in a day shift, starting at 07:00 or 08:00

Onze klant, een biotech bedrijf, gevestigd in Zwijnaarde, is een wereldwijd biotechnologiebedrijf dat de innovatieve CAR-T celtheraptie naar Gent brengt. Het bedrijf maakt hiermee dagdagelijks het verschil in het leven van vele patiënten die lijden aan kanker en andere levensbedreigende ziektes.
Ze zijn momenteel in een fase van sterke groei en zoeken gemotiveerde en toegewijde teamleden. 

Jobomschrijving

We’re looking for skilled individuals to join our mission of transforming medicine. This is more than just a job,it’s an opportunity to advance your career in a dynamic, purpose-driven environment. Whether you have a secondary education with hands-on experience or are a recent graduate with a bachelor’s degree in life sciences or related fields and especially if you’ve worked in cleanrooms, pharmaceutical manufacturing, or chemical processing,we’d love to hear from you.

We are looking for dedicated process operators to join our team at a leading biotechnology company. What can you expect in this exciting role?

Your journey begins with extensive training, where we immerse you in the world of aseptic (germ-free) and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) operations, including the crucial procedures you need to master.

Afterward, you will join our dynamic and driven Operations team, which works together every day to fulfill our mission. Alongside your fellow operators and team leaders, you will perform aseptic and manual production processes according to strict, proven procedures.

Daily aseptic and manual production processes

Working in a cleanroom lab environment

Executing production steps in controlled environments (grade A/B/C/D) such as spiking, media changes, cell culture, and freezing therapeutic products.

Managing equipment: inspections and maintenance

Thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials

Supporting transitions between production zones

Ensuring patients receive high-quality therapies on time

A strong sense of responsibility and passion to make a difference in the lives of patients.

Clear verbal and written communication skills with an attention to detail and the ability to follow procedures.

You thrive in fast-paced environments and are eager to learn and grow in advanced biomanufacturing.

You like structure and order, are very accurate and are willing to work in an aseptic environment with appropriate sterile clothing.

You have a relevant 'graduaat' or a bachelor’s degree. Alternatively, if you hold a secondary education diploma and have initial experience in a lab or cleanroom or hospital environment, pharmaceutical manufacturing, chemical processing, or similar regulated industries you are also eligible.

You are willing to work in a shift regime 4 days of working 4 days.

You speak very good English.

You’re excited to work with cutting-edge equipment and technologies

Our client is a leading international corporate real estate company. You will join a company offering a stable environment, strong team spirit and opportunities to develop your skills. They are located in the centre of Brussels close to the metro, bus and train stations in a new modern building.

Jobomschrijving

As Meetings & Event Coordinator, you will ensure successful planning and execution of meetings and events.

• Coordinate and support delivery of meetings, conferences and events from planning to execution.
• Prepare and set up meeting rooms and event spaces.
• Coordinate guest services, catering, transportation and other event-related logistics.
• Manage meetings and events calendar and contribute to post-event reporting and follow-up.
• Support in general office management.

• First experience in events, hospitality, office management or administration is a plus (internships included).
• Fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Service-oriented mindset and professional communication skills.
• Proactive, hands-on and able to work in a fast-paced environment.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word and Excel).

Nike ELC is an innovative employer with distribution centres in Laakdal and Tessenderlo-Ham and is responsible for all European Nike orders.

Jobomschrijving

As a warehouse worker for Nike ELC, you are trained to execute several tasks, such as loading and sorting of incoming and outgoing Nike products, orderpicking, labelling and packaging orders.

We are looking for all-round employees, who are flexible to rotate over several area’s and tasks.

Nike has excellent on-the-job training so you don’t need to have any relevant work experience; enthusiasm and willingness to learn are far more important!

 

	
• Your knowledge of English is very good (you can find vacancies for Dutch speaking candidates on www.startpeople.be/nike)	
• You want a full-time job and are eager to outperform during peak periods (working extended during weekends)	
• You want to work in an early and late shift pattern (06h00-14h00 Mon-Fri, 14h00-22h00 the week after)	
• You have your own means of transportation (the Nike campus is not accessible by bus or train)	
• You are looking forward to having a dynamic job that requires you to walk a lot and lift heavy orders (+/- 20 kg on a regular basis)

For our client in MIDDELKERKE, we are looking for a CHEF – THAI CUISINE.

This is a family-run business where, in time, you will have the opportunity to run the entire kitchen independently and take on responsibility within the business.

Do you have extensive knowledge of Asian cuisine, or do you have solid experience as a chef and are you eager to learn Thai cuisine? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Your responsibilities as CHEF – THAI CUISINE in MIDDELKERKE:

  • You are responsible for preparing dishes from the Thai cuisine;
  • You take care of the mise-en-place;
  • You cut vegetables and prepare meat and vegetable ingredients;
  • You ensure a professional presentation and finishing of the dishes;
  • You check deliveries and ensure that products are stored correctly;
  • You correctly store all products in the cold room; this is physically demanding work;
  • In time, you will take full responsibility for the kitchen and the entire menu independently;
  • You actively contribute to the daily operation and take responsibility within the kitchen.
This is you as CHEF – THAI CUISINE in MIDDELKERKE:

  • You have experience as a chef, preferably within Thai or Asian cuisine;
  • You can work independently and are comfortable taking responsibility;
  • A good command of English is important to learn and follow the recipes correctly;
  • You are reliable and take ownership of your kitchen;
  • You work accurately and maintain high standards of hygiene;
  • You are flexible and stress-resistant during busy services;
  • You are motivated to take on full responsibility for the kitchen in the long term.

Do you have a solid experience as a CE Truck Driver and enjoy delivering items from point A to point B? Then this might be exactly the opportunity you're looking for! We're looking for a reliable professional who takes pride in delivering vehicles in perfect condition.

In this role, you will take charge of transporting various vehicles, including vans and trucks, to different destinations. 

 
• Safely loading, securing, and unloading vehicles. 
Checking the load, transport documentation, and ensuring everything is delivered correctly. 

 
• Keeping the truck, trailer, and all equipment well-maintained and in top condition. 
 

 
• Providing a brief handover explanation when delivering the vehicle to the customer. 
 
• Representing the company professionally while on the road. 

 
• A valid CE driving license + Code 95. 
 
• Experience with vehicle loading, securing, and transport. 
 
•  
A precise, safety-focused way of working. 

 
•  
Proficiency in Dutch or English (French is a plus) 

 
•  
A friendly, professional communication style and appearance. 

 
•  
Flexibility: your schedule won't always be a standard 9-to-5; starting earlier or finishing later is part of the job.
